body:
#2687 is now at 139b6dfae7e50f90d8f5203844451fb7b86f8fd6. Fixes:
- CI: the audit doc was regenerated with the mandate rows.
- B1: validate on load (TTL<=24h, issued_at within skew, seat/scope/principal, regular 0600 own-uid non-symlink file); newest VALID wins; 0600 writes; monotonic stop via <id>.stopped tombstones; honest trust-boundary docs.
- B2: documented as an accepted risk.
- B3: append-only ~/.aida/mandates/exclusions.jsonl (0600, no symlink). If the ledger is untrusted, ALL mandate ships are refused. That's an author choice for you to rule on: a malformed final line blocks mandate ships until fixed by hand.
- B4: only typed supervision/decision/rework holds are released; missing, tampered, legacy, recusal or unknown holds are refused; re-arm on gate timeout, lapse and merge failure, with a loud report on re-arm failure. Behavior change: a supervised PR with NO hold marker can no longer be mandate-shipped.
- B5: Decide is always human.
Tests: 41 story_1698 + 866 related; check-ci-fast; check-ci-compile.
Next: dispatch a STRICT adversarial DELTA re-review (4a9444f3d3..139b6dfae7). Re-run the forgery, revoke-revival, history-rewrite (ledger) and marker-delete probes. The old session's fixer claimed STORY-1698, so YOU record the verdict. After approval the operator ships #2687 once (it's held), then runs 'aida mandate start --ship-held --include-supervised'.
subject: RESULT #2687 STORY-1698 mandate: all review findings addressed at 139b6dfae7; needs independent STRICT delta re-review
